title: RUSSELL PETERS
tickerText:
** TOURING NOW !!!**   RUSSELL PETERS IS A CANADIAN STAND-UP COMEDY SUPERSTAR, BORN IN TORONTO AND RAISED IN BRAMPTON, ONTARIO. FAMOUS FOR HIS LIGHTNING-FAST CROWD WORK, SHARP CULTURAL OBSERVATIONS, PLAYFUL ACCENTS AND FEARLESS IMPROVISATION, HE TURNS EVERY AUDIENCE INTO PART OF THE SHOW. WITH A GLOBAL FAN BASE AND DECADES OF SOLD-OUT PERFORMANCES, PETERS IS ONE OF THE MOST RECOGNISABLE NAMES IN INTERNATIONAL COMEDY.

TOUR DATES: OCT 1 – DETROIT, MICHIGAN • OCT 2–4 – APPLETON, WISCONSIN • OCT 8–10 – NEW BRUNSWICK, NEW JERSEY • OCT 15–17 – BRIDGEPORT, CONNECTICUT • OCT 23 – AMMAN, JORDAN • OCT 25 – YAS ISLAND, ABU DHABI • NOV 7 – ROHNERT PARK, CALIFORNIA • NOV 11–14 – MELBOURNE, AUSTRALIA • DEC 4 – ORLANDO, FLORIDA • DEC 6 – HOLLYWOOD, FLORIDA • JAN 21–23 – MILWAUKEE, WISCONSIN • JAN 28–30 – ALPHARETTA, GEORGIA • FEB 4–6 – SAN DIEGO, CALIFORNIA • FEB 11–13 – BREA, CALIFORNIA • FEB 19–20 – RAMA, ONTARIO • MAR 5–6 – VIRGINIA BEACH, VIRGINIA.
